 T he Nations League is the focus of my Friday football acca tips, with four selections, and the bet pays out at 2.79/1 if all of them are successful. You can read on for analysis of all the games I have picked from.
 Ron Wood’s acca @ 2.79/1 with bet365
 Scotland to beat North Macedonia @ 2/11
 Netherlands to beat Greece @ 1/2
 Germany to beat Serbia @ 2/7
 Switzerland to beat Slovenia @ 4/6

 Scotland, Netherlands, Germany and Switzerland to win

 Already a Sky Bet member? Check out more free bets from the best betting sites , reviewed by our experts
 Leg 1 – Scotland vs North Macedonia (kick-off, 7.45pm)
 My first pick in this football bet-builder tip is Scotland to win at home and there’s a straightforward case for that outcome, as the betting odds suggest.
 Scotland ran out 2-0 winners in the reverse fixture in Skopje last month and could have won by a greater margin, having 25 shots, 10 of them on target.
 North Macedonia did have the majority of the possession and got nine shots away themselves – but not one of them tested Angus Gunn in the Scotland goal.
 The visitors are bottom of Nations League Group B1, having lost all four of their matches without scoring. Scotland are third on four points after drawing 0-0 away to Slovenia in September .

 Leg 2 – Netherlands vs Greece (kick-off, 7.45pm)
 These sides played out a 2-2 draw in Thessaloniki last month, the Netherlands turning things around after trailing by two goals at the break.
 The countries are on eight points apiece in Nations League Group A2, with the Dutch sitting in top spot only on goals scored.
 The Netherlands dominated possession in October’s clash and can be expected to do so again. They do need to tighten up defensively, but it will be disappointing if they can’t find a way to come out on top this time, so they make my Nations League bet-builder tip.
 RON WOOD'S TIP
 odds provided by
 NETHERLANDS vs GREECE | NATIONS LEAGUE | FRI 13 NOV | 19.45
 Netherlands to win @ 1/2 
 Go to site 
 Leg 3 – Serbia vs Germany (kick-off, 7.45pm)
 Germany’s recent results have been mixed, but look no further than the meeting between these nations in October. Jurgen Klopp’s men won 2-0 that day but the scoreline doesn’t do them justice.
 Yes, Germany had home advantage and they are now on the road, but they were utterly dominant, having 32 shots, eight of them on target, to Serbia’s one. The xG (expected goals) was close to a 4-0 scoreline for Germany.
 Serbia have lost all four of their matches in Nations League Group A2. Germany have two draws and a defeat from their other games in this group, Greece beating them 1-0 in Augsburg in September with their only attempt on target.
 RON WOOD'S TIP
 odds provided by
 SERBIA vs GERMANY | NATIONS LEAGUE | FRI 13 NOV | 19.45
 Germany to win @ 2/7 
 Go to site 
 Leg 4 – Slovenia vs Switzerland (kick-off, 7.45pm)
 Switzerland are flying in Group B1. They were arguably unlucky to lose against Argentina in the World Cup 2026 quarter-finals, drawing 1-1 and appearing to be getting on top before having a man sent off and then losing in extra time.
 But any disappointment from that experience is being channelled the right way by the Swiss, who have subsequently won all four of their Nations League games.
 They were only 2-1 winners over Slovenia at home last month, having gone behind early, but they had the best of that game in terms of possession and chances. I’ll take Switzerland to maintain their 100 per cent record in this campaign as the final leg of my football bet-builder tips.
